description: Turn a plain-language brief ('dark, premium, fintech hero, a bit retro') into two or three starting settings for render_gradient. Understands jobs (hero, launch post, slide, screenshot, integrations, app store), moods and colors, product names (Linear, Stripe, Raycast…), styles (blobs, stripes, clouds) and finishes (retro/pixel, print/dither, terminal/glyph dither, film/grain, smooth). You are the taste layer: preview the candidates and adjust. No key needed.

aspectRatio.description: Frame shape to suggest for; otherwise inferred from the job (hero → 16:9, post → 4:5, …).

brief.description: What the background is for and how it should feel, in plain words: job, mood, colors, a product it should resemble, a finish.

name: suggest_settings

matched.description: How many of the brief's cues were recognised; 0 means generic fallbacks

title: Suggest settings from a brief
